Chimecho

Psychic

Hoenn · Generation 3

Chimecho is a Psychic-type Wind Chime Pokémon first found in Hoenn (Generation 3). It stands 0.6 m tall and weighs 1 kg. It evolves from Chingling. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (95), with a base stat total of 455.
